headline: Willock On Both Sides Of The Tyne
deck: Newcastle host Hull with three open ties running through the game, testf leading two of them
body:
Three duels come to the same pitch on Saturday afternoon, and none of them is settled. test2 arrive four men strong through Millar, Ajayi, Giles and Hall, all of them chasing the eight-goal deficit Egan has built for test1 alone. Ninety minutes will not close that gap, but it can start it.

The tighter fights sit in the middle of the table. test3 hold only Wissa here against Botman and Slater for test31121, a nil-nil tie waiting for a first return either way. And testf carry the whip hand, two clear over test31, with Willock, Tzolakis and Barnes set against Thiaw and Belloumi. Horníček watches for 123, McBurnie for test3331, neither with a duel to swing, both with points to take from a fixture that owes several managers plenty.
